verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client with an inbox chat assistant, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only documents Zero exposing its own MCP server (ZeroMCP tools for threads, labels, and drafts, authenticated with a session cookie). That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Zero connecting to or consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
